## Breakpoints

Frame was only designed at a single desktop width (1144px content / 1150px canvas). No tablet/mobile frames were provided.

| Name    | Width                                       |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| desktop | 1144px content width (page canvas 1150px)   |
| tablet  | not specified in Figma — see Open questions |
| mobile  | not specified in Figma — see Open questions |

## Assets

- Photos (JPEG/PNG) exported to `/src/assets/photo-1.jpeg` … `photo-6.jpeg`, `/src/assets/logo.png`.
- Icons exported as SVG to `/src/assets/icons/icon-01.svg` … `icon-20.svg` (Figma returned 20 of 20+ distinct icon vectors in the file; see Open questions — mapping to specific usages was not resolvable from metadata alone).
- Full-page screenshot reference saved to `/design/reference/home-screenshot.png`.

## Open questions

- No tablet/mobile frames exist in this Figma file — responsive breakpoints and behavior are undefined. Coding-agent should use standard responsive collapsing (stack columns, hamburger nav) as a reasonable default, but this is not spec'd by design and should be confirmed with the user before final sign-off.
- `text-[18px]` appears 4 times in the raw export but wasn't clearly attributable to a specific named heading level from metadata alone — coding-agent should treat it as a minor/caption-style text size distinct from body (16px) and confirm against the screenshot.
- Icon SVGs (20 exported) could not be deterministically mapped to their specific usage (e.g., which icon is "star rating" vs. "phone" vs. "email" vs. quick-fact icons) since Figma metadata doesn't expose that linkage without per-node asset calls. Coding-agent should visually match icons against `/design/reference/home-screenshot.png` per section, or substitute a consistent icon set (e.g. Heroicons outline) matching the visual style where an exact match is unclear, rather than guess a wrong SVG into a slot.
- Several `Image (Error loading image)` placeholder nodes appear in the Figma file (product card thumbnails, section illustration images). These map to the 6 raw photos exported to `/src/assets/`, but the exact photo→slot assignment isn't guaranteed 1:1 from export order alone — coding-agent should match photos to slots by content/aspect ratio using the screenshot reference, and flag any slot it can't confidently match.
